title: Sorting reorders only the customer summary rows; asset and invoice ordering is untouched
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. A customer with multiple assets and invoices is in the view.
steps: 2. Expand a customer and an asset; read the asset order and the invoice order.
expected: 1. Only the customer summary rows are reordered by the sort.
2. Asset rows keep their own order (A→Z with "Parts Sales" last) and invoice rows keep their order under their asset.
